name: date
desc: Date-line state. Formats date_str (uppercase MON DD) from the shared minute tick, sets the date TextLayer solely on change. No settings, no timers, no phone traffic.

cost.wakeups: none beyond the shared minute tick (no separate subscription)
cost.redraws: date text set solely when the formatted date changes
cost.notes: Font, color, box, and visibility stay in the design's text layer; the widget only feeds state.
